# DIY Sign Guy

> LED signs for business, built in my shop and shipped nationwide. DIY Sign Guy makes lighted outdoor business signs (illuminated cabinet signs, lightbox signs, light-up storefront signs) cut to the customer's size, with the LEDs already mounted inside and the power supply included. The customer or their local electrician installs it, and saves the sign-company markup. Run by Dean Brinley Jr., building signs since 2004.

## What I sell
- LED signs for business / lighted business signs: single- or double-sided illuminated sign cabinets for walls, poles and monuments, built to any size.
- Lightbox signs and light-up storefront signs for restaurants, shops, churches, offices and any small business.
- Pole and pylon sign kits, LED message centers, sign faces and printed graphics, LED retrofits for old fluorescent signs, and install hardware.

## How it works
1. Request a written quote at https://diysignguy.com/contact.html (Option 1, Sign Quote) with the size, sign type and install ZIP code.
2. Dean answers personally with a written quote. No sales team.
3. The sign is built to size with the LEDs installed, then shipped to the customer's door anywhere in the United States.
4. The customer, a handyman or a local electrician installs it, with Dean's guidance by email.

## Good to know
- Who it's for: small business owners who want a professional lighted sign without paying full sign-company prices, and sign shops that want a pre-built cabinet.
- Ships nationwide across the United States.
- Prices are given by written quote because every sign is built to its own size.
- Contact: dean@diysignguy.com. General questions: Option 2 on https://diysignguy.com/contact.html
- Your information is private. It is never sold.
